description: Use when an agent scans every perp listed on Hyperliquid, dYdX v4 and GMX v2 for funding arbitrage or crowding. Input: optional sort (spread, funding, oi, volume), order, limit (1-50), venues, min_venues, min_oi_usd. Output: JSON rows per coin with each venue's annualized funding, OI USD, 24h volume, max-min funding spread with short/long venue, mean APR, totals, coverage. Example: ?sort=spread&min_oi_usd=1000000 Price: $0.008 USDC (Base or Solana) via x402.

min_oi_usd.description: Only coins whose summed open interest >= this many USD

min_venues.description: Only coins listed on at least this many selected venues (default 2)

sort.description: Ranking: spread (max-min venue funding APR, default), funding (mean APR), oi (total USD), volume (total 24h USD)

venues.description: Comma list of at least 2 of hyperliquid, dydx, gmx (default all)

name: crypto_perp_screener
title: Cross-venue perp screener: Hyperliquid, dYdX and GMX funding, OI, volume and funding spread ranked
